card.name: Words just before an affected drug effect
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction text that sit right before the thing being changed, such as 'alteration of', 'counteracted', 'potentiate', 'does not alter' or 'effect of X on'. The next words usually name a drug effect or a plasma level.

modes.label: Of/on after alteration or effect
modes.description: Small linking words that lead into what is being altered, such as plasma levels or concentrations.

modes.label: Interaction verbs
modes.description: Verbs or verb parts that say one drug changes the action of another.
modes.example: Verapamil significantly counter<<acted>> the effects of quinidine on AV

modes.label: Inside interaction wording
modes.description: Partway through words or phrases that lead into an interaction statement.
modes.example: The presence of food in the stomach does not<< alter>> the bioavailability of lisinopril

card.writes: It seems to steer the model toward the word that follows an interaction verb or linking word, though the listed tokens are mixed and give little clear guidance.
card.plain: It lights up on the words that say one drug changes another drug's effect or levels, just before the thing being changed is named.
